description: The boolean shift operators B-SHIFT-L / B-SHIFT-R / B-SHIFT-LC / B-SHIFT-RC (ISO §2023:8.8.2 rule 8) — a COBOL-2023 addition (strictly later than the 2002 boolean operators B-AND/B-OR/B-XOR/B-NOT). Logical shift fills boolean 0; circular shift rotates. The second operand is an integer; the result length is the first operand's length (rule 9). Recognition-based gate (HasShiftOp) at the COMPUTE F2 / primaryCondition altitude, distinct from the boolean-operators-2002 gate.
citation: ISO §2023:8.8.2 rule 8 / Table 4; Annex E.2 (reserved-word additions)
source:
